func:
// ============================================================
// Atualiza a solicitação compatível com a confirmação recebida.
// ============================================================

const c = msg.actionConfirmation;

if (!c) {
    node.error("Dados de confirmação da ação ausentes.", msg);

    return null;
}

msg.query = `
    WITH candidate AS (
        SELECT id
        FROM agent_actions
        WHERE thing_id = $1::text
          AND action_name = $2::text
          AND input = to_jsonb($3::text)
          AND status = 'requested'
        ORDER BY requested_at ASC, id ASC
        LIMIT 1
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    )
    UPDATE agent_actions AS a
    SET
        status = 'confirmed',
        completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        result = jsonb_build_object(
            'property', $4::text,
            'value', $5::text,
            'topic', $6::text
        )
    FROM candidate AS cnd
    WHERE a.id = cnd.id
    RETURNING
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.thing_id,
        a.action_name,
        a.input,
        a.status,
        a.requested_at,
        a.completed_at,
        a.result;
`;

msg.params = [
    c.thing_id,
    c.action_name,
    c.input,
    c.property_name,
    String(c.state),
    c.topic
];

return msg;
